portfolio.title: Gaming Channel Engagement Thumbnail Strategy
portfolio.description:
Developed a high-impact YouTube thumbnail for a gaming content creator to boost click-through rates (CTR). The client needed a design that balanced professional aesthetic with high-energy emotional triggers.

Design Approach:

Visual Hierarchy: Used a green outer-glow effect on the subject to create separation from the background, ensuring the creator stands out.

Typography: Selected bold, sans-serif typography with high-contrast color pairings (White/Black/Green) to ensure readability on mobile and desktop devices.

Engagement Factors: Incorporated a 5-star rating graphic and a clear "Call to Action" (START NOW) to psychologically prompt user interaction.

This design was optimized to fit the "Prithvi Editify" standard of modern, clean, and conversion-focused visual assets.

portfolio.title: Culinary Content Series YouTube Thumbnail
portfolio.description:
Designed a clean, appetizing thumbnail for an Indian cooking tutorial series. The primary goal was to make the food the focal point while maintaining a cohesive look for the multi-part series.

Design Approach:

Visual Focus: Utilized a hexagonal frame to isolate the food imagery, providing a modern layout that contrasts with the warm color palette.

Color Palette: Employed a "Yellow and Brown" theme to evoke associations with warmth, tradition, and culinary quality.

Retention Elements: Integrated "Part 2" labeling to encourage binge-watching of the series, alongside clear "Watch Now" and "Subscribe" visual cues to optimize viewer engagement.

This project demonstrates my ability to align visual design with specific niche aesthetics (Food/Culinary) while maintaining the conversion-focused standards of Prithvi Editify.

portfolio.title: Nuclear Fallout - Gaming Thumbnail
portfolio.description:
The client needed a high-impact, clickable YouTube thumbnail for an intense, apocalyptic gaming video. The primary goal was to capture the viewer's attention immediately and convey a sense of extreme urgency to maximize the video's click-through rate.

To achieve this, Prithvi Editify designed a dynamic composition featuring three blocky, Roblox-style characters actively sprinting toward the viewer. The background was carefully composited to show a destroyed cityscape with massive nuclear mushroom clouds and fiery explosions. By combining bold, high-contrast typography reading "NUCLEAR FALLOUT" and "RUN NOW!" with dramatic lighting on the characters, the final deliverable successfully created a thrilling and immersive visual hook for the client's audience.

portfolio.title: YDP Connect 2026 Corporate Profile & Strategic Out
portfolio.description:
Client Overview: The client is YDP Connect, which stands for Youth Development Programme Connect. They are a community-focused organization located at 7 Millville Road, Millerton, Cape Town, 7441.

Client Goals: Their primary mission is "Connecting Youth to Opportunities," and they needed a professional design for the 2026 edition of their Corporate Profile & Strategic Outlook.

Project Scope: The project required cleanly organizing and highlighting their five core pillars: Career Guidance & Mentorship, Entrepreneurship Programme, Skill Development, Sports, and Arts & Culture.

Key Deliverables: We delivered a modern, visually engaging layout that incorporated their branding, program icons, and vital contact information, including their phone number (078 040 7128), website (www.ydpconnect.co.za), and email (Info@ydpconnect.co.za).

portfolio.title: Philippi Athletic Club Promo
portfolio.description:
The Philippi Athletics Club (PAC) is a sports organization based in Cape Town that welcomes runners of all levels, from beginners and walkers to competitive athletes. Their goal was to launch a successful recruitment drive to announce that memberships were officially open.

To support this community-driven initiative, Prithvi Editify designed engaging marketing assets and promotional text animations for their digital campaign. The challenge was to clearly communicate their wide range of offerings—such as Road Running, Cross Country, and Track & Field Training—while capturing their motivating ethos: "Run with purpose. Run with pride.". By combining dynamic, minimalist motion graphics with clear, centered typography for their contact data, the final deliverables successfully highlighted the club's mission to help members build discipline, confidence, and lifelong friendships.

portfolio.title: Green Spark Holidays - Vacation Package Promotiona
portfolio.description:
Green Spark Holidays needed a vibrant and engaging promotional poster to advertise their upcoming vacation packages for Thailand and Bali. The goal was to create a visually striking design that captured the excitement of travel while clearly communicating the distinct pricing for each destination and specifying that flights were excluded.

As the lead designer at Prithvi Editify, my challenge was balancing a breathtaking, high-resolution background image with clear, readable typography and pricing details without making the overall composition feel cluttered. I approached this by utilizing a clean visual hierarchy. I placed the primary hook, "Planning Vacation Trip?", in bold, inviting typography at the top, immediately drawing the viewer's eye.

Below that, I integrated the "Exclude Flight" detail within a stylized, airplane-themed badge to ensure transparency for potential customers. For the pricing section, I designed structured, dark overlays at the bottom to anchor the cost of the Thailand (₹19,000/-) and Bali (₹31,000/-) packages. This ensured the text popped against the colorful background without obstructing the beautiful scenery.

The final deliverable successfully combined an inviting, sun-drenched aesthetic with functional marketing elements. It prominently displayed the brand's logo, contact number, and website, providing the client with a compelling marketing asset

portfolio.title: Dubai & Malaysia Travel Package Social Media Poste
portfolio.description:
Dubai & Malaysia Travel Package Promotional Poster Design

Designed a premium social media travel advertisement for Green Spark Holidays to promote affordable family travel packages to Dubai and Malaysia.

The objective was to create an eye-catching, professional travel poster that communicates the destinations, pricing, and booking information clearly while maintaining a premium tourism brand appearance.

I focused on strong visual hierarchy, destination-focused imagery, bold typography, high-contrast pricing sections, clean information placement, and a modern travel aesthetic. The design was optimized for social media marketing and created to attract families looking for affordable international holiday packages.

My work included:
• Social media poster design
• Travel advertisement layout
• Typography and visual hierarchy
• Image composition and retouching
• Pricing and offer presentation
• Brand/logo placement
• Contact and website integration
• Final design optimization for social media

portfolio.title: Taalsphere Rhythmic Branding & Logo Design
portfolio.description:
As the lead designer at Prithvi Editify, I was commissioned to develop a comprehensive visual identity for Taalsphere. The client required a logo that effectively symbolized "rhythmic sound waves" while maintaining a modern, professional aesthetic.

The Challenge: Creating a design that balanced musical dynamism with clean, minimalist lines to ensure it functioned well across various digital platforms and print media.

The Solution: I developed a series of conceptual iterations focusing on circular sound wave motifs. After refining the motion and balance of the waves, we finalized a design that captured the essence of rhythmic sound. The final brand identity successfully positions Taalsphere as a modern, sound-focused entity.
